name: Komono (Japan)
description: A orange field charged at the centre with the Komono town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing the characters 菰野 with a curved stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Komono, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Komono town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing the characters 菰野 with a curved stroke
